releaseNotes: Adds 16 more contextual Bible dictionary studies covering exile, incense, martyrdom, Passover, the Beatitudes, diaspora, epistles, fasting, biblical interpretation, Hosanna, liturgy, messianic hope, exegesis, Paraclete, typology and new creation. Expands the study set from 107 to 123 across 205 terms, with contextual cautions and references checked against the offline KJV.
